title: Acquisition mix versus onboarding
prompt: Thirty-day retention fell from 82% to 69%. Product leadership blames a new onboarding flow. Determine the strongest supported explanation.
facts: Retention began declining before the onboarding release.
Paid-social share of new users rose from 18% to 47%.
Paid-social retention is 61%, organic is 84%, direct/referral is 86%.
Retention within each acquisition channel is approximately stable.
Onboarding completion fell from 88% to 74%, but completer retention changed only from 84% to 83%.
About 12% of paid-social users were mis-tagged as direct/referral and historical data was not backfilled.
